title: Fontaine–Mazur modularity at the prime 2
summary: OpenAI 数学仓库收录的研究手稿。展开查看英文摘要，或标记后让我进一步解释。

abstractEnglish: We prove that every continuous, irreducible, odd two-dimensional 2-adic representation of $`G_{\mathbb Q}`$, unramified outside finitely many primes and de Rham at 2 with distinct Hodge–Tate weights, is modular up to Tate twist. This resolves the odd, regular two-dimensional Fontaine–Mazur conjecture over ℚ at 2, including all residual representations.
